notes:
能连上 GitHub 时从 GitHub 下载，连不上再自动改用国内镜像。每个 Mod 可以要求最低管理器版本，版本不够时不会开始下载。公告在打开公告页时更新，不必发新管理器。
Downloads come from GitHub when it can be reached, and switch to the domestic mirror when it cannot. Each mod can require a minimum manager version, and an older manager does not start the download. Notices refresh when that page is opened, without a manager release.
